entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What is this door anyways?[n]It's pretty freakin' huge...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The Treasure is most likely ahead...[n]We're almost there.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Isn't there another way we can get in?[n]Try looking around, Joker!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: How have you not captured[n]the intruders yet!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I bet he'd never imagine we're[n]in the same room as him.[n]Come on, let's keep moving...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What're you doin'!? We're gonna[n]get caught if you go that way!
